description: Create an ACME EAB credential so an ACME client can obtain certificates from Certificate Manager (Certificate Manager 2.0). NPO_01 (OV) requires organizationNo. Public zone only. Works with main-account and Sub Account keys (Sub Account verified 2026-11-25; earlier the 2.0 API rejected Sub Account keys with HTTP 403).

validationMode.description: Validation mode: PRE (pre-validated domain) or DNS01

name: ncloud_cm2_create_eab_credential
